metadata.purpose: Explain token surface-vs-lemma differences for Japanese verbs/adjectives/copula/auxiliaries in already-tokenized NLP output
metadata.pipeline_assumption: lemma and POS are already assigned and broadly correct

source_seeds.notes: Japanese verb conjugation reference text (wiki-style dump)
Added modern standard Japanese morphology/orthography rules, exceptions, contractions, disambiguation

coverage_manifest.target_use_case: Already-tokenized Japanese text with lemma and POS assigned by NLP pipeline; classify why token surface differs from lemma for verbs/adjectives/copula/aux chains
scope_included: Modern standard Japanese productive verb morphology (godan/ichidan/suru/kuru)
i-adjective morphology including いい/良い inflection stem alternation
na-adjective + copula allomorphs relevant to token-level analysis
Core auxiliary chains (negation, past, passive, causative, polite, desiderative, te/de linkers)
Common colloquial contractions used as single tokens (じゃ, てる, とく, ちゃう, etc.)
Disambiguation rules for ambiguous surfaces using lemma/POS/context
Lexical exception registry for high-frequency irregulars and honorific -aru verbs
scope_excluded: Classical Japanese full conjugational system beyond selected still-seen auxiliaries/forms (ぬ/ず included only minimally)
Dialect-specific paradigms beyond high-frequency colloquial contractions
Orthographic noise / typos / OCR corruption / non-standard internet spellings not listed as aliases
Tokenizer-specific segmentation bugs outside lemma/POS constraints
coverage_manifest.completeness_claim: Comprehensive for modern standard Japanese token-level verb/adjective/copula surface-vs-lemma explanation when lemma and POS are already correct, within declared scope.

metadata.completeness_statement: Comprehensive for modern standard Japanese token-level verb/adjective/copula surface-vs-lemma explanation when lemma and POS are already correct, within declared scope.

ambiguity_resolution.conditions: lemma=だ AND pos in {AUX,COP} OR (xpos indicates copula/adjectival-copula form)
pos=PART OR deprel in {case,mark} OR lemma!=だ
lemma=て AND pos in {PART,SCONJ} AND prev_state expects voiced te-form
lemma=た AND pos=AUX AND prev_state in {EXPECTS_TA_SLOT_T,EXPECTS_TA}
lemma=た AND pos=ADJ? tokenizer-specific past auxiliary labeling

lexical_exceptions.notes: Use って/った, not いて/いた
いい inflects via よ- (よく, よかった, よくない)
良い/よい inflect via よ-
Honorific -aru class yields なさい/なさいます stem behavior
くださる→ください / くださいます
いらっしゃる polite/imperative stem irregularities
おっしゃる irregular honorific stem
ござる→ござい- in polite forms
Both older/lexicalized variants may occur depending lexeme/register
